places.detail: |tr²g1·g2·g1·g2⁻¹ − 4| + |tr[g1·g2·g1·g2⁻¹, g2] − 2| ≈ 0.80384758 < 1. ⟨g1·g2·g1·g2⁻¹, g2⟩ is non-elementary: tr[g1·g2·g1·g2⁻¹, g2] ≠ 2 (no common fixed point) and neither trace is 0 (neither swaps a pair of points); a finite group would need an element of order ≥ 7 and so be cyclic or dihedral.
